Buffer Stock The service provider shall maintain an optimum buffer stock equivalent to 15 days’ requirement within the NSO–HSD premises to ensure uninterrupted supply. The contractor shall supply water bottles manufactured not earlier tha n 0-1 months prior to delivery. Each bottle must have a minimum remaining shelf-life of 6 months at the time of supply. The contractor shall replace any bottles that are damaged, expired, leak ing, overused, or visually unfit, whenever required. The daily requirement of 1-litre water bottles is approximately 50, wh ich may increase or decrease depending on actual consumption. The total estimated requirement for one year is 14,000 bottles. The successful bidder may raise a monthly bill along with proof of actual supply. Payment will be made based on verification/validation through sto re receipt records.
